protocol: evidence_seek_v1: composite task for the integration layer -- K identities, noisy clue frames (p=reliability), query frames ask 'what is identity X' (X uniform in observation); agent answers X's value (+1 correct, ends) or requests a clue for a self-chosen identity (-0.01, next unit shows it); timeout at units units. PPO on-policy, no teacher/oracle. Controls: mlp_no_memory (memoryless, capped at reliability), gru_policy (compressed state), jeplem_policy (explicit slots). Probes: answer accuracy/rate, episode reward, request-vs-oracle-max-gap match.
